d:
The Suns defeated the Pelicans, 123-119 tonight in New Orleans. Jalen Green finished with a team-high 25 points along with 3 rebounds and 3 three pointers for the Suns, while Devin Booker tallied 22 points, 8 assists and 5 rebounds in the game. Jordan Poole recorded 28 points, 6 three pointers and 3 assists. The Suns improve their record to 9-7 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 5-14 for the season.
